rent.note: Furnished 1-room flat (living room plus separate kitchen, 30–45 m²) in central Medeu district / Golden Square / Samal. Live krisha.kz monthly asking rents run 250,000–500,000 KZT, typical 300,000–350,000. 320,000 KZT is about $720 at 444.08 KZT/USD. Utilities are usually extra, and a one-month deposit is common. City-wide average is lower (about $440, Krisha Jan 2026).

utilities.note: Electric, water, central heating and home internet. Wise gives £69 utilities plus £12 internet for an 85 m² flat (about $107 at 0.756 GBP/USD), scaled to a 35–45 m² flat. Heating is billed per m² in winter.

groceries.note: Home cooking. Wise gives £159/month per person (about $210); Green Bazaar and Magnum/Small supermarkets.

diningOut.note: Derived: about 15 meals out at about $8 average (canteen lunches 1,500–2,500 KZT; Wise inexpensive restaurant £9) plus about 15 specialty coffees at 800–1,500 KZT.

transit.note: Onay monthly pass 9,900 KZT (about $22) covers bus, trolleybus and metro (120 KZT single, cashless only since 3 August 2024), plus about $16 of Yandex Go taxis.

coworking.note: Impact Hub Almaty monthly is reported at 45,000 KZT (about $101). No operator price page could be opened; one 2026 guide declines to print prices at all.

simData.note: Tele2 'Безлимит для всех' unlimited-data tariff, 4,790 KZT per 30 days. Beeline and Kcell are similar.

misc.note: Gym, banya, toiletries, Medeu/Shymbulak tickets, buffer. Matches Tbilisi ($100).

accomSeasonality._doc: Editorial. The monthly rental market is mostly residents, so swings are mild. There is a small summer uplift (mountain season, regional visitors) and slightly softer rents in Nov–Mar.
